text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that Dream Journey wasn't feeling 
well, I decided to let her rest in the 
infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Taking you up on your kindness, I shall 
take a short rest here.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: (This is...)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Where are we? Why are we even in a 
place like this?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Kh! What a sturdy door! Not even my 
Princess Punch will work on it!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
So basically, the five of us are locked in 
this closed room?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? This is totally the kind of thing 
where some crazy incident happens in a 
drama. Spooky~.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Please rest assured, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"The one who invited the four of you here 
was none other than myself."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Actually, lurking among us is the culprit 
behind a certain incident.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Around noon, the culprit snuck into the 
Trainer's room and ate the hidden sweets.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"I would like you all to discuss this 
among yourselves and uncover who the 
culprit is."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I-It wasn't me! I have an alibi, I was 
with Vodka at noon!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
However, Vodka-san isn't here to prove 
that, is she?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Th-That may be true, but... What about 
everyone else?"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
As a princess, I bring my own sweets. I 
would never sneak in to steal them!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, got it. In that case, since I 
just ate a burger myself, I don't have a 
motive either.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Even if we try to deduce it, we have far 
too few clues here...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Journey-san, is the culprit really in 
here?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes, there is no mistaking it.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I clearly stated it. That the culprit is 
among us.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufufufu... *nom nom nom*

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. What an absurd, ridiculous dream.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Did an empty stomach trigger that weird 
dream...? Either way, having an appetite 
is proof that I'm in good shape.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps thanks to proper rest, Dream 
Journey managed to get back into top 
shape.
